i1562.translation: My disciple, come quickly to save me, so you can still see me.
i1562.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||徒弟啊，速来救我，还得见面#1

i1563.text: 没饭吃，饿死了，还得个完全身体归阴。
i1563.gloss: not.have food eat, starve die PFV, still DE CLF complete body return underworld
i1563.translation: If she dies of hunger with no food to eat, at least she’ll still get a whole body to return to the underworld.
i1563.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||没饭吃，饿死了，还得个完全身体归阴。#1

i1564.text: 打虎还得亲兄弟，上阵须教父子兵。
i1564.gloss: fight tiger still DE own brother, go.to battle must make father son soldier
i1564.translation: To fight a tiger, you need your own brother; to go into battle, it must be with father and son as soldiers.
i1564.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||打虎还得亲兄弟，上阵须教父子兵。#1

i1565.text: 此酒果是素酒，弟子勉强吃了，还得见佛成功
i1565.gloss: PROX wine truly COP vegetarian wine, disciple reluctantly drink PFV, still DE see Buddha succeed
i1565.translation: If this wine truly is vegetarian wine, I will reluctantly drink it and can still see the Buddha and achieve enlightenment.
i1565.key: 16th Century CE|Xiyouji||此酒果是素酒，弟子勉强吃了，还得见佛成功#1

i1566.text: 但愿应时还得见，须知胜似岳阳金。
i1566.gloss: only wish timely still DE see, must know surpass Yueyang gold
i1566.translation: I only hope that in due time I may see you again - for that would be better than all the gold of Yueyang.
i1566.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||但愿应时还得见，须知胜似岳阳金。#1

i1567.text: 种瓜还得瓜，种豆还得豆。
i1567.gloss: plant melon still DE melon, plant bean still DE bean
i1567.translation: If you plant melons, you’ll get melons; if you plant beans, you’ll get beans.
i1567.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||种瓜还得瓜，种豆还得豆。#1

i1568.text: 只还得原借三百金回家，也好过日。
i1568.gloss: only return DE original borrow three hundred gold return home, also good pass day
i1568.translation: Please only collect the repayment of the originally borrowed three hundred taels and return home - that would at least allow us to get by.
i1568.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||只还得原借三百金回家，也好过日。#1

i1569.text: 拜了四拜，学士只还得两个揖，甚不过意。
i1569.gloss: bow PFV four bow, scholar only return DE two CLF salute, very NEG feel.right
i1569.translation: He bowed four times, while the scholar merely returned two salutes — which he found quite improper.
i1569.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||拜了四拜，学士只还得两个揖，甚不过意。#1

i1570.text: 既是小姐的东西，还得小姐来讨，方才还他。
i1570.gloss: since COP young.lady ATTR thing, still DE young.lady come claim, only.then return 3SG
i1570.translation: Since it belongs to the young lady, she must come to claim it herself before it can be returned to her.
i1570.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||既是小姐的东西，还得小姐来讨，方才还他。#1

i1571.text: 这银两须要仔细，请收过了，只要还得价钱公道便好。
i1571.gloss: PROX silver must careful, please receive over PFV, only.if return DE price fair then good
i1571.translation: Please handle this sum of silver carefully and accept it; as long as the repayment is at a fair price, that’s all that matters.
i1571.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||这银两须要仔细，请收过了，只要还得价钱公道便好。#1

i1572.text: 应时还得见，胜是岳阳金。
i1572.gloss: timely still DE see, surpass COP Yueyang gold
i1572.translation: I only hope that in due time I may see you again - for that would be better than all the gold of Yueyang.
i1572.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||应时还得见，胜是岳阳金。#1

i1573.text: 正是投瓜还得报，善人不负善心人。
i1573.gloss: exactly COP throw melon still DE repay, good person NEG fail good heart person
i1573.translation: Truly, when you offer a melon, you’ll be repaid in kind — a good person never fails one with a kind heart.
i1573.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||正是投瓜还得报，善人不负善心人。#1

i1574.text: 临终还得个好断送，只怕你老人家没福。
i1574.gloss: near end still DE CLF good send.off, only fear 2SG.HON not.have fortune
i1574.translation: At least when you die, you will get a proper send-off; I just fear that you may not have such good fortune.
i1574.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||临终还得个好断送，只怕你老人家没福。#1

i1575.text: 种麻还得麻，种豆还得豆。
i1575.gloss: plant hemp still DE hemp, plant bean still DE bean
i1575.translation: Plant hemp and you get hemp; plant beans and you get beans. (Proverb: You reap what you sow.)
i1575.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||种麻还得麻，种豆还得豆。#1

i1576.text: 也得老身见他一见，与他讲道方好。
i1576.gloss: also DE 1SG.HUM see 3SG one see, with 3SG talk reason only.then good
i1576.translation: I must see him myself and speak some reason to him; only then will it be proper.
i1576.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||也得老身见他一见，与他讲道方好。#1

i1577.text: 况孩儿新娶媳妇，也得他拜见公公方是。
i1577.gloss: moreover child newly marry wife, also DE 3SG pay.respect father-in-law only.then right
i1577.translation: Moreover, my son has just taken a wife; it is necessary for her to pay respects to her father-in-law. That is the proper way.
i1577.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||况孩儿新娶媳妇，也得他拜见公公方是。#1

i1578.text: 所以有这样事，也得他经一遭儿，警戒下次。
i1578.gloss: therefore have PROX.kind matter, also DE 3SG undergo one time, warn next time
i1578.translation: So this happened... it was necessary for him to experience it once, as a warning for the future.
i1578.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||所以有这样事，也得他经一遭儿，警戒下次。#1

i1579.text: 奶奶这里收拾起来，也得好几日。
i1579.gloss: madam here tidy start, also DE quite several day
i1579.translation: For you to tidy your things here, madam, it will need quite a few days.
i1579.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||奶奶这里收拾起来，也得好几日。#1

i1580.text: 也得他趁少年美貌，别寻头路。
i1580.gloss: also DE 3SG take.advantage young beautiful.looks, separately seek way
i1580.translation: He should, while still young and beautiful, find another path for himself.
i1580.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||也得他趁少年美貌，别寻头路。#1

i1581.text: 弹琴时也得个知音的人儿在傍喝采方好。
i1581.gloss: play qin time also DE CLF know music ATTR person at side cheer only.then good
i1581.translation: When playing the qin, it would be truly good to get a connoisseur nearby to applaud.
i1581.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||弹琴时也得个知音的人儿在傍喝采方好。#1

i1582.text: 仙姑卧房何处？是什么纸帐？也得小生认一认。
i1582.gloss: immortal.lady bedroom what place? COP what paper curtain? also DE 1SG.HUM recognize one recognize
i1582.translation: Where is the immortal lady's bedchamber? What kind of paper bed-curtains does it have? I must go and take a look.
i1582.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||仙姑卧房何处？是什么纸帐？也得小生认一认。#1

i1583.text: 我们人众，分不来，极少也得二十两。
i1583.gloss: 1PL person many, divide NEG come, at.least also DE twenty tael
i1583.translation: There are many of us; it's not enough to divide. At the very least, we must have twenty taels of silver.
i1583.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||我们人众，分不来，极少也得二十两。#1

i1584.text: 若在外恁般游荡，也得好些银子使费，他却从何而来？
i1584.gloss: if at outside such loaf, also DE many silver spend, 3SG but from where CONJ come?
i1584.translation: If one were to live so dissolutely outside, it would require a great deal of silver for expenses. Where, then, does he get it from?
i1584.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||若在外恁般游荡，也得好些银子使费，他却从何而来？#1

i1585.text: 小妇人嫁与刘贵，虽是做小老婆，却也得他看承得好
i1585.gloss: 1SG.HUM marry to Liu.Gui, although COP be concubine, but also DE 3SG treat DE good
i1585.translation: Although I married Liu Gui as a concubine, I also got to be treated well by him.
i1585.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||小妇人嫁与刘贵，虽是做小老婆，却也得他看承得好#1

i1586.text: 做个小小经纪，也得过养身活命。
i1586.gloss: do CLF small small broker, also DE pass nourish body live life
i1586.translation: Working as a small broker, one can also get by and make enough to live on.
i1586.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||做个小小经纪，也得过养身活命。#1

i1587.text: 你快快说来，也得我心下明白。
i1587.gloss: 2SG quickly say come, also DE 1SG heart below clear
i1587.translation: Hurry up and tell me, so that I can understand what is going on.
i1587.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||你快快说来，也得我心下明白。#1

i1588.text: 连那鸡儿狗儿，餂了鼎中药末，也得相随而去
i1588.gloss: even DIST chicken dog, lick PFV cauldron inside medicine powder, also DE mutually follow CONJ go
i1588.translation: Even the chickens and dogs, having licked the medicinal powder in the cauldron, also got to ascend (to heaven) along with them.
i1588.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||连那鸡儿狗儿，餂了鼎中药末，也得相随而去#1

i1589.text: 不如还了俗去，娶个老婆，生男育女，也得夫妻团聚。
i1589.gloss: NEG as.good.as return PFV lay.life go, marry CLF wife, bear son raise daughter, also DE husband wife reunite
i1589.translation: It would be better to return to secular life, marry a wife, have children, and also get to enjoy the life of a family.
i1589.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Awaken the World||不如还了俗去，娶个老婆，生男育女，也得夫妻团聚。#1

i1590.text: 哥哥，既然放他不得，抛在湖中，也得个全尸而死。
i1590.gloss: elder.brother, since release 3SG NEG DE, throw at lake inside, also DE CLF whole corpse CONJ die
i1590.translation: Brother, since we cannot let him go, if we throw him in the lake, he will at least get an intact body when dying.
i1590.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||哥哥，既然放他不得，抛在湖中，也得个全尸而死。#1

i1591.text: 今日是初五、也得做兄弟的发个利市。
i1591.gloss: today COP fifth, also DE be brother NMLZ give CLF good.luck.gift
i1591.translation: Today is the fifth (of the month); I, as your brother, must give you a gift for good luck.
i1591.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||今日是初五、也得做兄弟的发个利市。#1

i1592.text: 小夫人要来张胜家中，也得我娘肯时方可。
i1592.gloss: young mistress want come Zhang.Sheng home inside, also DE 1SG mother willing time only.then acceptable
i1592.translation: If the young mistress wants to come to Zhang Sheng's home, it must be when my mother agrees.
i1592.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||小夫人要来张胜家中，也得我娘肯时方可。#1

i1593.text: 德称口如悬河，宾主颇也得合。
i1593.gloss: Decheng mouth like hanging river, guest host quite also DE harmony
i1593.translation: De Cheng spoke with great eloquence, and the guest and host also got harmony (got along quite well).
i1593.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||德称口如悬河，宾主颇也得合。#1

i1594.text: 我今日为求嗣而来，做一件好事回去，也得神天知道。
i1594.gloss: 1SG today for seek heir CONJ come, do one CLF good matter return go, also DE god heaven know
i1594.translation: I came today to pray for an heir; I will do a good deed before I leave, so that it can be the case the the gods of heavan knows of the good deed.
i1594.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||我今日为求嗣而来，做一件好事回去，也得神天知道。#1

i1595.text: 我两口儿老来也得所靠。
i1595.gloss: 1PL two mouth old come also DE NMLZ rely
i1595.translation: The two of us (husband and wife), when we are old, will also get someone to rely on.
i1595.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||我两口儿老来也得所靠。#1

i1596.text: 列位，你既劝我不要到官，也得我骂他几句，出这口气。
i1596.gloss: everyone, 2SG since persuade 1SG NEG want go official, also DE 1SG curse 3SG several CLF, vent PROX CLF anger
i1596.translation: Everyone, since you've persuaded me not to report this to the authorities, you must at least let me curse him a few times to vent my anger.
i1596.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||列位，你既劝我不要到官，也得我骂他几句，出这口气。#1

i1597.text: 倒不如自眼里看他结末了，也得明白。
i1597.gloss: rather NEG as.good.as own eye inside watch 3SG end PFV, also DE clear
i1597.translation: It would be better to watch with my own eyes how he meets his end; that way, I can have a clear understanding.
i1597.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||倒不如自眼里看他结末了，也得明白。#1

i1598.gloss: 1SG nine spring GEN below, also DE close eye
i1598.translation: In my grave, I will be able to rest in peace.
i1598.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||我九泉之下，也得瞑目。#1

i1599.text: 要备起送文书，府县公门也得些使用。
i1599.gloss: need prepare dispatch document, prefecture county yamen also DE some expense
i1599.translation: We need to prepare the official documents, and the government offices will also acquire some 'expenses' (i.e., bribes).
i1599.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||要备起送文书，府县公门也得些使用。#1

i1600.gloss: why NEG demand? also DE 3SG willing return!
i1600.translation: (You asked) Why not demand it back? (Even if I did,) it would still depend on him being willing to return it!
i1600.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||怎么不讨？也得他肯还！#1

i1601.text: 你便早死，我们也得早早回京。
i1601.gloss: 2SG if early die, 1PL also DE early early return capital
i1601.translation: (Your death is certain) If you die early, we can also return to the capital at once.
i1601.key: 17th Century CE|Stories to Caution the World||你便早死，我们也得早早回京。#1

i1602.text: 讨这花枝般的女儿，自家也得精神对付他
i1602.gloss: marry PROX flower branch like ATTR girl, REFL also DE energy handle 3SG
i1602.translation: To marry such a beautiful (flower-like) girl, one must have the energy to handle her.
i1602.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||讨这花枝般的女儿，自家也得精神对付他#1

i1603.text: 若遇著这二位官人，也得他些资助，好无福分！
i1603.gloss: if meet bump.into PROX two CLF gentleman, also DE 3SG some aid, very not.have fortune!
i1603.translation: If only I had met these two gentlemen, I could have at least gotten some financial help from them. What terrible luck!
i1603.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||若遇著这二位官人，也得他些资助，好无福分！#1

i1604.text: 若是小心与他相好，钱财也得了他的。
i1604.gloss: if COP careful with 3SG mutually good, money also DE PFV 3SG NMLZ
i1604.translation: If I had been careful and gotten on good terms with him, I would have gotten his money too.
i1604.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||若是小心与他相好，钱财也得了他的。#1

i1605.text: 拚些上下使用，身上也得干净。
i1605.gloss: risk some up down expense, body on also DE clean
i1605.translation: If you're willing to spend some money on bribes (for 'expenses' up and down the ladder), your criminal charges can be cleared up.
i1605.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||拚些上下使用，身上也得干净。#1

i1606.text: 不如挺身首官，便吃了一剐，也得名扬于后世。
i1606.gloss: NEG as.good.as stand.forward confess official, even suffer PFV one slicing, also DE name spread to later generation
i1606.translation: It would be better to turn myself in. Even if I am executed, my name can at least be known to posterity.
i1606.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||不如挺身首官，便吃了一剐，也得名扬于后世。#1

i1607.text: 虽然董四哥吃了些亏，也得了个好消息。
i1607.gloss: although Dong fourth.brother eat PFV some loss, also DE PFV CLF good news
i1607.translation: Although Fourth Brother Dong suffered a bit of a loss, he also received some good news.
i1607.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||虽然董四哥吃了些亏，也得了个好消息。#1

i1608.text: 取得这项银两，一路上盘缠，也得宽裕，免致吃苦。
i1608.gloss: take DE PROX CLF silver, whole.way on travel.money, also DE ample, avoid cause eat bitterness
i1608.translation: Once we get this silver, our travel expenses for the journey can be sufficient, and we can avoid suffering hardship.
i1608.key: 17th Century CE|Stories Old and New||取得这项银两，一路上盘缠，也得宽裕，免致吃苦。#1

i1609.text: 论理我们里头也得他来整治整治，都忒不像了。
i1609.gloss: by reason 1PL inside also DE 3SG come discipline discipline, all too NEG proper CRS
i1609.translation: Logically, he ought to come and sort us out, too; we've all become too improper.

i1640.translation: ...so that we can cheer up a bit.

i1801.gloss: but 3SG not.have move, as.if because earlier not.have think.of PROX.way most natural most save.trouble ATTR method CONJ feel-DE should ashamed as.if
i1801.translation: But he didn't move, as if because he hadn't thought of this most natural and easy method earlier, he felt he should be ashamed.

i1802.text: 那裡有養駝的，他得趕快的走，能在天亮的時候趕到，把駝出了手
i1802.gloss: there have raise camel NMLZ, 3SG DE quickly ADV walk, can at sky bright ATTR time hurry arrive, BA camel out PFV hand
i1802.translation: There were people who raised camels there, he must walk quickly, to be able to arrive at dawn and sell the camels.
i1802.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|那裡有養駝的，他得趕快的走，能在天亮的時候趕到，把駝出了手#1

i1803.text: 他不曉得現在駝有什麼行市
i1803.gloss: 3SG NEG know-DE now camel have what market.price
i1803.translation: He didn't know what the market price for camels was now.
i1803.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|他不曉得現在駝有什麼行市#1

i1804.text: 因為駝力氣大，而吃得比騾馬還省。
i1804.gloss: because camel strength big, CONJ eat DE than mule horse still frugal
i1804.translation: Because camels have great strength, and eat more sparingly than mules or horses.
i1804.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|因為駝力氣大，而吃得比騾馬還省。#1

i1805.text: 他不希望得三個大寶，只盼望換個百兒八十的
i1805.gloss: 3SG NEG hope DE three CLF big treasure, only hope exchange CLF hundred eighty P
i1805.translation: He didn't hope to get three 'great treasures', only hoped to exchange for a hundred or eighty.
i1805.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|他不希望得三個大寶，只盼望換個百兒八十的#1

i1806.text: 山在西，城在東，他曉得這個。
i1806.gloss: mountain at west, city at east, 3SG know-DE PROX CLF
i1806.translation: Mountains in the west, city in the east, he knew this.
i1806.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|山在西，城在東，他曉得這個。#1

i1807.text: 好象噩夢初醒時那樣覺得生命是何等的可愛。
i1807.gloss: as.if nightmare just wake time DIST.way feel-DE life COP what.degree ADV lovely
i1807.translation: Like when just waking from a nightmare, (he) felt how lovely life was.
i1807.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|好象噩夢初醒時那樣覺得生命是何等的可愛。#1

i1808.text: 他既沒死在山中，多渴一會兒算得了呢？
i1808.gloss: 3SG since not.have die at mountain inside, more thirsty one while count DE finish SFP?
i1808.translation: Since he didn't die in the mountains, what did being thirsty for a while count as? (Rhetorical: it counts for nothing).
i1808.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|他既沒死在山中，多渴一會兒算得了呢？#1

i1809.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|他覺得非常的難堪#1

i1810.translation: He didn't know what was best.
i1810.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|他不曉得怎樣好了。#1

i1811.text: 對於調動駝的口號，他只曉得「色……」是表示跪下
i1811.gloss: regarding move camel ATTR command, 3SG only know-DE Se COP indicate kneel down
i1811.translation: Regarding commands for moving camels, he only knew that "Se..." meant kneel down.
i1811.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|對於調動駝的口號，他只曉得「色……」是表示跪下#1

i1812.text: 他很得意的應用出來，特意叫村人們明白他並非是外行
i1812.gloss: 3SG very DE-intent ADV apply out come, specially make villager-PL understand 3SG at.all NEG.COP COP layman
i1812.translation: He applied it very proudly/satisfyingly, specifically to let the villagers understand he wasn't an amateur.
i1812.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|他很得意的應用出來，特意叫村人們明白他並非是外行#1

i1813.text: 年頭兒變了，誰還喂得起駝！」
i1813.gloss: times change CRS, who still feed DE up camel!
i1813.translation: Times have changed, who can still afford to feed camels!
i1813.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|年頭兒變了，誰還喂得起駝！」#1

i1814.text: 老者又細細看了祥子一番，覺得他絕不是個匪類
i1814.gloss: old.man again carefully look PFV Xiangzi one round, feel-DE 3SG absolutely NEG COP CLF bandit.type
i1814.translation: The old man looked at Xiangzi carefully again, and felt he was definitely not a bandit.
i1814.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|老者又細細看了祥子一番，覺得他絕不是個匪類#1

i1815.text: 養馬的見了馬就捨不得
i1815.gloss: raise horse NMLZ see PFV horse then bear NEG DE
i1815.translation: A horse raiser seeing a horse hates to part with it.
i1815.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|養馬的見了馬就捨不得#1

i1816.text: 懂行的人得到個便宜，就容易忘掉東西買到手中有没有好處。
i1816.gloss: know trade ATTR person DE arrive CLF bargain, then easy forget off thing buy arrive hand inside have not.have benefit
i1816.translation: A person who knows the trade, getting a bargain, easily forgets if having the item in hand is of any benefit.
i1816.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|懂行的人得到個便宜，就容易忘掉東西買到手中有没有好處。#1

i1817.text: 乾脆就留下吧，瞧著辦得了！
i1817.gloss: simply then leave down SFP, look DUR do DE finish!
i1817.translation: Just leave them here, we'll see what to do! (Colloquial phrase).
i1817.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|乾脆就留下吧，瞧著辦得了！#1

i1818.text: 祥子是那麼誠懇，弄得老頭子有點不好意思了
i1818.gloss: Xiangzi COP DIST.way sincere, make DE old.man have bit embarrassed CRS
i1818.translation: Xiangzi was so sincere, (it) made the old man a bit embarrassed.
i1818.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|祥子是那麼誠懇，弄得老頭子有點不好意思了#1

i1819.text: 二三十塊？離買車還差得遠呢！
i1819.gloss: two three ten CLF? from buy rickshaw still fall.short DE far SFP!
i1819.translation: Twenty or thirty dollars? That's still far off from buying a rickshaw!
i1819.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|二三十塊？離買車還差得遠呢！#1

i1820.text: 看得出，你不是幹這一行的！
i1820.gloss: see DE out, 2SG NEG COP do PROX one trade NMLZ!
i1820.translation: (I) can tell (see out), you don't work in this trade!
i1820.key: 20th Century CE|Rickshaw Boy|3|看得出，你不是幹這一行的！#1
